freefg.profile: default (seven FP16 U-Net forms; generated images differ slightly from Intel)

method.reactive_mask: Disabled in all conditions through the Cyberpunk/HelixSR recipe; removes a temporal-reconstruction input. No image-quality equivalence to mask-on is claimed.
method.comparison: Same full GOG 2.5_RedModFix install, High RT-off, 80-degree FOV, HelixSR 2.0.0 Quality 1706x960 to 2560x1440; reactive mask disabled. Same DLSS FG input to XeFG for 2x/3x/4x. Reflex Enabled, XeLL Disabled/cap zero, Anti-Lag2 Disabled. All caps, VSync, output/frame-start pacing off. Headless 240 Hz. Intel controls disable shader acceleration and use an empty wave table. Only 3x/4x load separately supplied MFG Unlocker 1.6.0, XeFGModel=default; both Intel and FreeFG at these factors carry an unofficial category label.
method.intel_control: BC250_XEFG_DISABLE=1 and XEFG_WAVE_CONFIG pointing to an empty wave-table file: no FreeFG shader replacements or wave overrides.
method.game_fps: Number of frames.csv rows / benchmark elapsed seconds.
method.output_fps: Cyberpunk summary averageFps, including generated frames on the DLSS FG input to XeFG route. Verified summary frameNumber / frames.csv row count matches requested factor in every run.
method.interval: Student-t 95% confidence interval over four run means (df=3); describes repeatability on this machine, not generalization to other systems.
method.pacing: VSync, game/XeLL/OptiScaler caps, BC250_XEFG_PACE and BC250_XELL_PACE disabled in every condition; this measures throughput, not VRR pacing or input latency.
method.latency_settings: Reflex enabled, XeLL frame cap zero, native Anti-Lag 2 disabled in every condition. DLSS FG also enables Reflex automatically. No input-latency measurement is claimed.
method.cache: Fresh per-condition Mesa and vkd3d cache folders under mfg26-cache/. One full unscored warm-up, reused for the four measured runs. Pilot caches separate.
method.ordering: Four blocks, each containing all fourteen conditions. Blocks 2/4 reverse 1/3; every condition has the same average position. All fourteen full warm-ups finish before scoring.
method.rejection: Stop on first technical invalidity. Retain every raw run. No FPS-based exclusion or replacement of failed runs; any changed protocol is a separate campaign.
method.settings: High graphics settings, ray tracing off, 80-degree field of view; DLSS Quality input selects HelixSR. The game labels this Custom after the upscaler selection. Full settings hash retained per run.
method.gpu_governor: Dynamic, 500–1850 MHz; configured endpoint request 860 mV, not a fixed measured voltage. Throttling begins at 88 °C.
method.derived_cost: N_m = (1000 / mean_game_fps_m - 1000 / mean_game_fps_no_fg) / (m - 1), ms per generated frame; total added time per game frame is N_m*(m-1). Throughput-derived overhead, not an isolated GPU-stage or latency measurement.
method.derived_cost_repeatability: Point estimate uses reciprocal unrounded means. JSON also gives the four paired-block estimates and their observed range; no cost confidence interval is plotted.
method.unofficial: Intel XeFG at 3x/4x on this GPU requires separately supplied MFG Unlocker 1.6.0 with XeFGModel=default; these categories are marked unofficial.

derived_cost_ms_per_generated_frame.basis: difference of reciprocal mean game FPS, divided by generated frames per game frame
